name: Clearing Member Role
definition: Member of an exchange's clearing corporation, responsible for executing client trades and involved in the clearing of trades.

Side.name: Side
Side.definition: Specifies the side of the clearing member.

ClearingSystemMemberIdentification.name: Clearing System Member Identification
ClearingSystemMemberIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier of a clearing system member, assigned by the system or system administrator.

ClearingAccount.name: Clearing Account
ClearingAccount.definition: Identifies the clearing member account at the CCP through which the trade must be cleared (sometimes called position account).

MarginAccount.name: Margin Account
MarginAccount.definition: Margin account where the negociation and liquidation risks will be calculated.

DeliveryAccount.name: Delivery Account
DeliveryAccount.definition: Account opened by the central counterparty in the name of the clearing member within the account structure, for settlement purposes (gives information about the clearing member account at central counterparty).

DefaultFundAccount.name: Default Fund Account
DefaultFundAccount.definition: Specifies the account identification of the clearing member at the ICSD (International Central Securities Depository) or at the Central Bank.

ClearingSegment.name: Clearing Segment
ClearingSegment.definition: Clearing segment within a clearing organisation that allows the segregation of flows coming from clearing counterparty's clearing system.

RelatedClearingMemberRole.name: Related Clearing Member Role
RelatedClearingMemberRole.definition: Clearing member for which a clearing segment is specified.
